target_customer: Developers and enterprises building voice AI agents for phone and web, such as support and sales calls
problem: Building natural-sounding voice bots needs orchestration of speech-to-text, language models, text-to-speech, telephony and low latency, which is slow for a team to assemble.
business_model: Usage-based API and platform with enterprise contracts

founders.name: Jordan Dearsley
previous_startups: Superpowered (meetings app, pivoted to Vapi in 2023)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no prior employers or education.

founders.name: Nikhil Gupta
previous_startups: Superpowered (meetings app, pivoted to Vapi in 2023)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no prior employers or education.

technical_complexity.rationale: Chaining speech, language model and voice services with sub-second latency and telephony is standard engineering with hard real-time parts; the platform was assembled from third-party models.

defensibility.rationale: Orchestration over third-party models is copyable, and many rivals appeared; enterprise integrations and developer mindshare provide some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Model and telephony providers offer adjacent voice products, yet no acquisition is reported; Vapi raised a Series B in May 2026.

market_need_then: Large voice and contact-center spend plus rapid improvement of language models in 2023 made automated phone agents newly feasible; the company later reported Amazon Ring moving its inbound support to Vapi.

branding.domain_note: Uses vapi.ai, an .ai domain; no purchase history found.

identity.logo: Proprietary marks governed by a published brand page
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct and builder-focused (for example 'Voice agents for builders')

branding.brand_signature: VapiCon voice AI summit and the developer-first positioning

rebrands.why: Pivot from a meetings app to a voice API platform

branding.community_and_virality: Runs a branded event, VapiCon, and a large developer base; sources show no memes or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong developer awareness and a named event, but no source shows a distinctive consumer-style brand asset.

pivots.to: Vapi, a voice API platform for bots
pivots.why: Founders said they were burned out on the original product after years; TechCrunch reported the pivot in November 2023

outcome_analysis: Vapi is the pivoted successor of the YC W21 company Superpowered. After the November 2023 pivot to a voice API it raised a seed, a $20M Series A in December 2024 and a $50M Series B in May 2026, riding the language model wave and enterprise wins like Amazon Ring. Risks are heavy competition and reliance on third-party model vendors.
notes: The YC W21 batch belongs to the earlier product Superpowered, so competition as of the batch concerns a meetings app; no dated competitor source was found and the list is empty. Voice AI rivals (Retell, Bland, Synthflow) emerged after the 2023 pivot and are not recorded here. Seed figure rests on a secondary outlet; the Series A valuation of 130M comes from a Reuters report citing an unnamed source; TechCrunch reported a 500M valuation in May 2026 without clarity on pre or post money. Founder education and employers were not found. Founding year conflicts across sources (2020 to 2022).
